subject: front view of an adult male anime head (toon shaded, hair on) compared with the official MHS3 render of Leo, both framed so the distance D from the pupil line to the chin bottom is 303 px and the pupils sit at the same place
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 official character render (Leo): semi-realistic anime, toon colours with soft painted shadow shapes, thin dark-brown outlines

chin_and_jaw.reference: The face outline runs down from the cheekbone with a convex curve, turns at a soft jaw corner level with the mouth, and ends in a broad rounded chin about 0.5 D wide at 0.95 D below the pupils.
chin_and_jaw.ours: The face outline runs in a nearly straight diagonal from below the ears to a narrow chin about 0.35 D wide at 0.95 D below the pupils, a V shape with no jaw corner.

ears.reference: The ears are behind the cheeks, top at brow height, bottom at about 0.38 D below the pupils; mostly a shadowed inner shape.
ears.ours: The ears stick out at the sides as long tabs, top just above the pupil line, bottom at about 0.48 D below the pupils, level with the nose bottom.

brows.reference: Thick dark-brown brows angled down toward the nose, the inner end lowest and almost touching the upper lash line; the gap from the brow's lower edge to the pupil is about 0.08 D.
brows.ours: Thick brown brows almost horizontal with a small downward hook at the inner end, sitting high: the gap from the brow's lower edge to the pupil is about 0.16 D, with bare skin between brow and lash.

eyes.reference: Eye opening about 0.31 D wide and 0.55 as tall as wide, the heavy dark upper lash slanting down to the outer corner; the green iris fills the height of the opening, its top cut by the lash and its bottom touching the lower lid; grey-white sclera only at the sides.
eyes.ours: Eye opening about 0.33 D wide and 0.55 as tall as wide, rounder top; the green iris is cut at the top by the lash, and a band of white sclera shows under it along the lower lid as well as at both sides.

nose.reference: A broad pale highlight patch down the lit side of the nose bridge from the eye line to near the tip, a short soft shadow on the other side and a small orange-brown shape under the tip.
nose.ours: A thin pale vertical stripe down the centre of the nose from the eye line to 0.4 D, then a small orange-brown oval under the tip; no side shadow.

face_shading.reference: Painted soft-edged shadows: a darker band under the fringe across the forehead, a broad shadow down one side of the face and under the cheekbone, warm orange-brown shadow colour; a pale rim on the other cheek.
face_shading.ours: The face is one flat skin colour with no shadow under the fringe and no side shadow; only the neck is darker; two pink blush ovals on the cheeks.

hair_volume.reference: The hair rises about 1.07 D above the pupil line with full rounded volume, broad clumps with many thin painted light streaks and dark lines; the fringe falls in a few broad pointed clumps to the brows.
hair_volume.ours: The hair rises about 0.79 D above the pupil line and sits close to the skull, made of many thin straight spikes in two flat browns; the fringe is several thin spikes hanging over the eyes.

neck.reference: The neck is mostly hidden by a high collar; where it shows it is in shadow and narrower than the jaw.
neck.ours: A bare neck column about 0.6 D wide, darker than the face, nearly as wide as the jaw.
